pages: A plain brass ring lies in wet grass among elder roots at the end of a hedge lane, half in the mud. Middle distance: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, standing over it looking down. Background: the lane at Nettlebed, March dusk. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, stands in the farmyard turning the plain brass ring over on one finger, her brow pulled down. Middle distance: her cap on the dry-stone wall, a nest of leaves and moss. Background: the thatched cottage and byre behind. Low evening light across the yard.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, holds her thumb up before her face and stares hard at the plain brass ring on it, her mouth slightly open, her shoulders drawing in. Middle distance: the dry-stone yard wall, her cap hanging on it. Background: the lane at Nettlebed, March evening. One low warm light against blue shade.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, stands alone in the farmyard with her right fist closed and turned inward against her chest, the brass ring hidden, staring at the lane mouth. Middle distance: her cap on the wall, the byre door ajar. Background: hedge lane running down past the cottage. Evening, the light going cold.

A scraped doorstep and a broom against the wall in front of a low cottage. Middle distance: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, sitting on the step looking at nothing. Background: the byre and a bare lane, spring afternoon. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, kneels at the elder roots with a grey slate propped on her knee and a stub of white chalk pinched in her fingers, turning the brass ring with her thumb as she thinks. Middle distance: elder roots, wet grass. Background: hedge lane at Nettlebed, soft grey daylight. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Foreground: an open cottage door and a bucket on the step. Middle: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, in the doorway with one shoulder on the frame, chin lifted. Background: byre and lane under a bright June sky. Light: hard June sun, sharp shadow on the wall.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, sits on the cottage step with one hand closed over the brass ring on her thumb and her eyes down on the ground in front of her boots. Middle distance: the cottage door, her cap in her lap. Background: the yard, the byre, the lane. Warm afternoon light, long shadows.

Foreground: a wooden bucket by the wall and the byre door ajar. Middle: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, standing in the farmyard with her arms folded tight over her chest, brow knit. Background: cottage and lane, midsummer. Light: warm and still, one long shadow.

Foreground: a yard gate standing open and a dry-stone wall. Middle: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, standing very still against the cottage wall, her eyes on the gate. Background: farmyard, byre and lane. Light: high summer, cool blue shade.

Foreground: the byre door ajar and a cap hanging on the wall. Middle: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, standing in the farmyard with one hand open at her waist, her eyes down on the brass ring. Background: cottage and lane, midsummer. Light: warm on the hand, blue behind.

Foreground: a plain brass ring lying in wet grass among elder roots, one edge of it catching light. Middle: the hedge gap at a top gate, a dropped grey slate. Background: the lane above Nettlebed in the rain, a bare hedge running away. Light: wet grey daylight, one warm edge on the ring.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, stands at the kitchen board with a knife in one hand, a half loaf cut open on the wood. Middle distance: a blackened kettle on the hearth, a crock of butter. Background: a low kitchen window, whitewashed wall. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Foreground: a kitchen board with a half loaf cut open and a knife laid down flat. Middle: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, standing behind it, staring at the shut door. Background: a low window, a whitewashed wall, a blackened kettle on the hearth. Light: fading August, one candle.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, stands in the elder roots at the top gate with a grey slate in one hand and a stub of white chalk in the other, the brass ring on her thumb. Middle distance: the gate post, elder roots. Background: the lane and the valley below Nettlebed. First of September, light going.

A flat stone wall runs along the edge of a field at a top gate above a lane dropping into a valley at dusk. Middle distance: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, sitting on the wall looking down the lane. Background: Nettlebed below, first of September. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, stands at the top gate with her arms crossed tight against the cold, head tipped down, listening. Middle distance: a lamp standing on the gatepost, a slate in the grass. Background: the cottage and byre below, full dark. One warm light, long soft shadows.

A cottage yard with a gate standing open across the foreground, grass and a pail on the ground. Middle distance: Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, standing inside the yard with both hands on the gate as she swings it shut, chin up. Background: the cottage door and the byre, Sunday morning. One warm light, long soft shadows.

Hanne, fifteen, dark hair plaited flat, a deep madder-red collarless work smock, walks away up the lane past the shut gate, the brass ring turned inward on her thumb. Middle distance: the gate, the cottage wall, a bare hedge. Background: the lane out of the farmyard, late morning. Late morning sun down the lane.
